_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a place to count to, or one neighbour to check against a fixed number or letter (a K after a vowel); 2: one neighbour with a property to check (an even number after a prime), or a fixed middle with both neighbours; 3: both neighbours checked for a property (between two primes, between two squares), or places counted from both ends; 4: a condition that also says what must not be there, or places numbered and checked themselves (prime places, multiples of 3). Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
